review: Updating my 2-star review from 3 years ago. This app has actually gotten worse. If you just want to stream this works fine enough. If you want to download your playlists for HiFi music on the road look elsewhere. This app will constantly disable your offline music and the only option is to delete everything and re-download every few days. I have a 1TB internal drive on my phone (Samsung Fold 4). The app will start to bug out once I hit around 7K downloaded songs. The downloads just freeze up.
